newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 105-day T-bills yield 8.470 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 105-day T-bills yield 8.470 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 105-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 8.470 percent versus 8.970 percent for the NZ$75 million of a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The average yield for NZ$75 million of 196-day bills was 8.010 percent versus 8.443 percent for the $75 million of similar treasury bills at the last tender.
The average yield for $50 million of 385-day bills was 7.732 percent versus 7.834 percent for the $50 million of similar treasury bills tendered last week.
